# Wharf 0.14.0 implementation review

## Status

Implementation is validated for release.

## Findings

- Status reads are pure and do not mutate event streams or summaries.
- ETA is derived only when completed work provides a measurable rate.
- Stop cancellation precedes bounded graceful waiting.
- Cleanup receives only explicitly identified ephemeral resources.
- Durable evidence is never passed to cleanup.
- Completion and blocked notifications are persisted; webhook delivery
  requires an explicit HTTPS endpoint.

## Validation evidence

Formatting verification, Release build, and the complete suite passed all 69
tests with zero warnings or errors.
